method: Built-in image editing; original supplied phone designs reformatted as landscape artwork.

entries.prompt: Edit the supplied Orange App Store promotional image into a landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 2752 × 2064 pixels. This is a faithful layout reformat, NOT a redesign. Use the source image's existing phone mockup and all its exact screen content unchanged as a single photographic cutout. Preserve the phone angle, bezel, entire display, icons, numbers, small text, photo, and QR pattern exactly. Do not substitute an iPad device, do not invent app screens. Place the original phone large on the right half, with comfortable margins and all of the original visible content retained. Move the original headline into the left half, vertically centered, in the same bold white Outfit typography. Exact headline, with natural line wrapping: "friends and money no one can take away". Keep the original black-to-dark-charcoal subtle gradient background extended seamlessly across the new landscape canvas. No extra text, labels, decorations, or new logos. Retain any original small red-square Orange logo in the lower-left if present. Keep original black, white and red colors. All text sharp and readable. Output a single complete opaque landscape 4:3 image, not a contact sheet. User wants simply their existing artwork reformatted; keep all visual details faithfully.
